source_text.body_text:
You think you are making safe choices, but you are actually letting fear drive the car. The mind builds walls out of past mistakes and fake worries to stop you from taking a leap. It disguises this panic as plain common sense.

To grow, you must step outside the familiar zone. If you listen to the loud voice telling you to stay put, you will never find out what you can actually build. You must learn to ignore the noise and walk into the unknown.
